notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
description:
Cast Rory Williams by paying {W}{U}.
Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.
